V9.0

  • Major overhaul of controlnet

    • you no longer need to reset the switches

  • Added the ability to use original image ratios

    • Can use the Aspect Ratio node, or...

    • can switch the size to match teh iage ratio all the way through the entire workflow

  • Completly reworked the brains 🧠

    • Added a sigma multiplier

    • Reworked the detailer daemon so it isn't always just a "bypassed" node

  • Added my B&W◼️🔲+ Color 🌈 Suite

    • allows you to micromask down to hair fibers

    • select an item by naming it (or several)

    • The item will mask and turn the rest of the image B&W.

    • Complete control over the fade, color match, and saturation

  • Added the option tocolor matchto the original image

    • tweaked the settings for more precise matching

  • Updated Notes 📝 throughout.
